messages:
ashwin: quick share — I ran an adaptive-concurrency headroom sim for Dedicated pools serving the new 30B family (q4f16 and q8 variants) across us-west-2, eu-west-1, and ap-southeast-1. curious if the numbers match your expectations.
maria: nice — can you paste the sim assumptions? batch sizes, target p99, traffic profile?
ashwin: sure. assumptions: steady-state 80% RL load, 70k requests/day, request size mean 512 tokens, tail traffic spikes up to 3x for 10m windows. target p99 latency = 120ms. autoscale policy used: min_instances=2, max_instances=32, scale_up_cpu_threshold=0.75, cooldown=60s.
samir: paste of the key outputs: us-west-2 H100 mix (kernel=fused-v2) -> p50=42ms p95=85ms p99=118ms throughput 480k tok/s per pool at 8 concurrent reqs; eu-west-1 A100 (kernel=generic) -> p50=58ms p95=110ms p99=160ms throughput 340k tok/s. ap-southeast-1 H100 but older driver (kernel=fallback) -> p50=60ms p95=130ms p99=210ms.
eva: noted regression in apac when using q4f16 — qualitative evals show ~3% drop on entity extraction on our anchor prompts compared to q8. not huge but above our threshold for rollout without compensating prompts.
maria: so for capacity sizing, what headroom are we recommending? 30%? 50% for apac because of higher p99?
ashwin: recommendation: target concurrency headroom = 40% for us-west-2 H100 (because fused-v2 kernel behaves consistently), 60% for eu-west-1 A100 if using generic kernels for 30B (or move to tuned kernels), and 80% for ap-southeast-1 until driver/kernel is upgraded. translates to reserve instances multiplier: us-west -> x1.4, eu-west -> x1.6, apac -> x1.8.
jon: can you show the simple calculation? e.g., baseline pool size for steady peak qps -> instances * gpus_per_instance?
samir: yep. short calcs we used: peak_concurrency_required = (peak_rps * mean_tokens) / (throughput_tokens_per_gpu). example us-west: peak_rps=120 rps, mean_tokens=512 => 61440 tok/s. throughput_per_gpu=480k tok/s -> gpus_needed ~= ceil(61440/480000)=1. So baseline 1 GPU, with 40% headroom -> 1.4 -> round up to 2 GPUs in pool. eu-west example gives baseline 2 -> headroom -> 3. apac baseline 2 -> headroom 4.
eva: for rollout plan: can we do canary in us-west with q8 first, enable KV caching, then try q4f16 in canary with eval hooks? want to catch quality regressions early.
maria: +1. also add a perf gate: if p99 > 150ms for canary we abort.
ashwin: I'll push a small RFC with the pool counts and autoscale config. attaching the sim CSV next.
deploy-bot: Attached file: headroom-sim-1890123456.csv (uploaded)
ashwin: uploaded the CSV and a short notebook with the charts (latency curves by region + kernel) in the thread. comments welcome — main open items: (1) kernel tune path for eu-west-1 A100, (2) driver upgrade roll for apac, (3) decide conservative vs aggressive headroom multipliers.
maria: thanks — let's sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to lock numbers before we create the Dedicated offer artifact.
